updated_paragraph: **Dependency update (2026-11-16):** [#20](https://github.com/DRAGGON-Lab/FENIX/issues/20) is **completed** through merged [PR #61](https://github.com/DRAGGON-Lab/FENIX/pull/61), supplying verified immutable FIR and P03 mathematical digest. [#21](https://github.com/DRAGGON-Lab/FENIX/issues/21) is **completed** through merged [PR #63](https://github.com/DRAGGON-Lab/FENIX/pull/63), supplying the P04 native Python ODE executor. **#22 remains open**: source-linked run manifests, typed result serialization and verified readback still require P07 ratification and their separate implementation/verification review. [PR #64](https://github.com/DRAGGON-Lab/FENIX/pull/64) remains contract/evidence-only; #29 and #42 retain separate gates.
